You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: The module `Github715` is a minimal TLA+ specification, likely a test or regression case, modeling a single Boolean variable that alternates between `TRUE` and `FALSE`. The sole variable `x` is initialized to `TRUE` by `Init`, and the next-state relation `Next` simply negates `x` on each step. The temporal specification `Spec` combines the initial condition with a stuttering-tolerant always-`Next` box formula.

The model-checking configuration checks the temporal property `Prop`, which asserts that `x` holds (i.e., is `TRUE`) at all times. Because `Next` flips `x` on every non-stuttering step, this property is not an invariant and will be violated once `x` becomes `FALSE`. The module also defines `Prop2` (asserting `x = TRUE`), `Prop3` (trivially `TRUE`), and `SpecVar` (an alias for `x`), though only `Prop` is checked in the configuration. The specification serves primarily as a small example or issue-reproduction case rather than a model of a real system.
